summary.text: Marty Feltus, a Republican from Lyndon, represents Caledonia-3 in the Vermont House of Representatives, where she served from 2013 to 2022 and again since 2025.
She is vice chair of the House Committee on Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Feltus has lived in Lyndon for 45 years and has been active in local organizations ranging from the Mother's Club to the Northeastern Vermont Development Association, according to her House biography.
Her professional experience includes international sales, customer management, continuous improvement and strategic planning.
She has served 25 years as an elected town official.
In her earlier House service she took part in the Committees on Natural Resources and Energy, on Appropriations, on Joint Information Technology, and on Prevention of Sexual Harassment.
